request.requested_format: pseudonymised data in a secure processing environment
request.purpose: We validate a risk prediction model for the public health authority. Aggregates are not sufficient: the prediction error must be measured for each patient inside the secure environment.
request.question: Provide pseudonymised diagnoses and medications for adults with heart failure. Only model performance metrics will be exported.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
